correctness.rationale: R=Z[X]/Phi_pq gives C multiplication by X and C^pq=I. For C^p-I, quotient by X^p−1 has p−1 invariant factors q (other factors 1), since Phi_pq Phi_q=Phi_q(X^p) kills by q and reduction modulo q identifies F_q[X]/Phi_p of dimension p−1; the proof exchanges p and q. Hence F1=1 from Phi_pq(1)=1, Fp=gcd(q,m)^(p−1), Fq=gcd(p,m)^(q−1), Fpq=m^d. Möbius inversion for divisors 1,p,q,pq gives nonnegative integer cycle multiplicities. A separate direct exhaustive modular state walk was performed for (p,q,m)=(3,5,2),(3,5,3),(3,5,5),(3,7,2),(3,7,3), 932979 states, and matched. Boundary m=1 gives a single fixed point; general proof not based on these tests.
